description: This file provides utility functions related to payment handling within the application, including building UPI deep links, attempting to open them, and generating payment summary texts.

methods.name: toQuery(params)
methods.description: Encodes key=value pairs into a UPI query string, filtering out undefined, null, or empty values.

methods.name: buildUpiDeepLink({ pa, pn, am, tn, cu = 'INR', tr, url })
methods.description: Builds a UPI deep link URL with specified payment parameters.

methods.name: tryOpenDeepLink(href)
methods.description: Attempts to open a deep link using window.location.href.

methods.name: getPaymentSummaryText({ patient, slot, amount })
methods.description: Returns a formatted string summarizing the payment details for the user.

ctags.name: buildUpiDeepLink
ctags.pattern: /^export function buildUpiDeepLink({ pa, pn, am, tn, cu = 'INR', tr, url }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ pa, pn, am, tn, cu = 'INR', tr, url })
